paper_title: What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical   Specialty Data in Medical LLMs
caption: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline Mistral-v0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. Each group represents tokens categorized into different clinical specialties. Each color means that the same model is further fine-tuned on each specialty data.
model_annotation: The grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of clinically relevant per-specialty terms, comparing a baseline "Mistralv0.2-Base" model against models fine-tuned on six distinct clinical specialty datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Per-specialty terms," which are organized alphabetically from left to right: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and features a downward-oriented linear scale ranging from -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. Consequently, all vertical bars extend downwards from the top baseline of -22. Each category on the horizontal axis contains a group of seven adjacent bars. According to the legend positioned above the chart, the first bar in each group is colored light blue and represents the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model. The subsequent six bars in each group correspond to the models "Fine-tuned on:" the specific specialties, which are arranged alphabetically and color-coded in a gradient from lightest to darkest: Cardio (lightest peach), Gastro (light orange), Infect (medium-light orange), Neuro (medium orange), Obstetrics (dark orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Visually, the light blue baseline bars extend the furthest downward in every group. The longest bar overall is the baseline model in the Cardio category, extending to approximately -26.8, while the shortest bars are found in the Infect category, where the fine-tuned models extend downward to only about -23.0. Within each category group, the six fine-tuned model bars display similar downward lengths, ranging broadly across the chart from roughly -23.0 to -26.1. Both the horizontal axis categories and the fine-tuned model legend items are sorted alphabetically, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with outlines or additional annotations.
